result.title: One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test
result.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Code, data and the commit history of the pre-registration: https://github.com/renorai/gemma4-memory-study
result.summary: When a coding agent runs out of room, its earlier findings are cut and it forgets them. We tested a simple fix: automatically putting the agent's last finding back in front of it. We fixed the rules in advance and ran 98 paired coding tasks with and without this reminder, using Gemma 4 31B (QAT, 4-bit) in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent harness. The reminder made no measurable difference: across all 98 tasks, 47 were solved with it and 48 without (-1.0 points, 95% interval [-8.3, +6.3], exact McNemar p=1.0). The primary outcome (a documented deviation from our preregistration), the first 48 pairs, was 29/48 with memory against 25/48 without (+8.3 points, [-2.1, +18.3], p=0.22); the extension of 50 tasks, decided after that result, pointed the other way (18/50 against 23/50, -10.0 points, p=0.125), so the sign did not replicate. With 19% of tasks flipping between two identical no-memory runs, the combined interval excludes harms larger than about 8 points and gains larger than about 6, and the design had 80% power only for effects of about +-12 points or more. The model almost never wrote notes (2 of 16 and 4 of 32 runs), and memory cost context: the first request is larger and something was injected at only 47% to 65% of compactions. The registered secondary, repeated actions per compaction, was also null. Two directional hypotheses found on Modal did not replicate on Kaggle. We also report an A/A calibration and a validity funnel (129 tasks, 105 valid). Together these results show that single-run memory claims on task sets of this size sit inside run-to-run noise. The treatment is a harness mechanism and does not test agent-written memory.

AI.brief_summary: 在一个 Gemma 4 31B 编程 agent 上做预注册配对实验，检验「上下文被压缩时自动重新注入上一条发现」这一简单记忆修复是否提升 98 个编程任务的解决率，结果未检出可测量的差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩时重新注入先前状态」的机制可与 LVR 中推理状态与视觉证据的跨步保存、注入位置和上下文成本对照；配对设计、A/A 校准与功效分析也提供了核查 latent 干预因果收益的测量线索。
